prompts.landscape: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone fantasy-game reminder preview background, wide landscape composition. A restrained hand-painted peaceful fantasy valley with distant blue-sage mountains, an old woodland path, quiet meadow and sparse walnut-dark trees at the edges. Soft morning light, muted sage and teal with warm earth, realistic painterly craftsmanship matching aged bronze and walnut leather game UI. Low contrast, subdued detail and open uncluttered central space so an independently rendered icon and ivory text remain readable. Edge-to-edge scenic illustration, no UI, no frames, no text, no letters, no characters, no logos, no glow effects. Landscape canvas 3:2.
prompts.parchment: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone illustrated parchment preview material for a restrained handcrafted fantasy-game UI. A single horizontal piece of warm ivory parchment with gently irregular aged edges and slight shallow edge curls, viewed directly from above, all four edges fully visible. Wide 5:2 rectangle with generous transparent padding, no cast shadow beyond the object. Fine low-contrast natural fibers, quiet light ivory center for independently rendered dark text and icon, subtly warm tan edges, upper-left soft lighting. Restrained painted realism, tasteful aged material rather than stained distressed paper. Actual transparent background outside parchment. No writing, letters, runes, symbols, border decoration, seals, objects, UI, mockup, checkerboard or watermark.
